text:
maya: RFC follow-up: customers want per-tenant precision pins (fp8) but ops needs safe auto-fallback. how do we keep config small and safe?

tony: propose a small contract: `preference_list` + `safety_gates` (deg_threshold, latency_ms, canary_rate). router picks highest-ranked variant that passes gates.

ali: add `cache_compat` flag. if false, switch triggers KV prefix flush for that conversation; if true, allow hot switch. default false.

maya: rollback semantics? in-flight requests should finish on original precision; new requests follow new variant. avoids partial responses.

ops-bot: scheduled sampling job to measure flush penalty for tenant_xyz at 2026-04-03T09:00Z.

tony: API surface: put `precision_policy_id` on routes and store reusable policy objects. easier to update many routes.

ali: require conservative defaults: quality-first policy and an "aggressive-cost" preset. enterprise needs explicit consent for policies that may change output semantics.

maya: per-call override via SDK header is risky. allow only if policy declares `allow_per_call: true` and we audit.

tony: action items: maya draft policy schema (due 2d), ali prototype decision path in toy harness (due next Tue), ops-bot run sample job and post results (ETA today).

maya: also add nightly shadowing of fp8 to compute deltas vs baseline so we catch regressions before enabling for customers.

ali: ack, will add to ops playbook.

maya: thanks, team :thumbsup:
